    StartersBlue corn chips with red chile salsaBlue corn chips with a smoky dried red chilli salsaHow to make it4 dried red chillies3 tomatoes1 garlic bulb1 lime230g blue corn chipsToast the dried red chillies in a dry pan, soak in hot water 15 minutes and drain.Blitz with the tomatoes, the garlic cloves, the juice of the lime and salt until smooth.Serve with the blue corn chips.Los Alamos green chile cheeseburger slidersMini beef burgers with cheddar and charred green chilliHow to make it4 long green chillies500g beef mince8 slices of cheddar4 tbsp mayonnaise1 tin chipotle in adobo8 slider buns1 jar dill picklesChar the long green chillies over a flame or under a grill until blackened, sweat in a bowl, peel, seed and chop.Roll the beef mince into balls.Smash flat in a very hot pan, season and cook 2 minutes.Flip, top with the chillies and a slice of cheddar each, cover 1 minute.Mix the mayonnaise with the chipotle in adobo.Toast the slider buns and build with the chipotle mayonnaise, patties and pickles.Cambridge apple, cheddar and walnut toastsThe apple young Oppenheimer leaves on his tutor's desk at CambridgeHow to make itAs written, serves 4Toasted sourdough with melted vintage cheddar, thin slices of crisp apple, toasted walnuts and a drizzle of honey and thyme.Slice 1 small sourdough into 12 thin slices and toast under the grill until golden on one side.Turn, lay on 200g sliced vintage cheddar and grill 2 minutes until bubbling.Core 2 crisp red apples and slice very thin.Top each toast with a fan of apple, scatter with 50g chopped toasted walnuts, drizzle with 2 tbsp honey and finish with thyme leaves and pepper.Pinto bean and cheddar tostadasBeans on the plate, the way Kitty's Joe lived on them.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsTrinity test green chile stewPork, potato and chilli stew. Now I am become Death.How to make it1kg pork shoulder1 onion1 garlic bulb6 green chillies600g potatoes1 L chicken stock8 flour tortillasBrown the diced pork shoulder, then soften the onion and the garlic cloves.Char the large green chillies, peel, chop and add with the diced potatoes and the chicken stock.Simmer 90 minutes until the pork is tender.Serve with the warm flour tortillas.New Mexico red chile pork posoleA Los Alamos feastHow to make itAs written, serves 4Pork shoulder simmered with hominy in a deep red chilli broth until tender, topped with shredded cabbage, radish, lime, oregano and crisp tortilla strips.Soak 4 dried ancho chillies in boiling water 20 minutes, then blend with 3 garlic cloves and 250ml of the soaking water.Brown 1.2kg pork shoulder chunks in a pot.Add 1 diced onion, the chilli purée, 1.5L chicken stock, 2 tsp oregano and 1 tsp cumin and simmer 2 hours.Add 2 drained 800g tins of hominy and simmer 20 minutes.Serve topped with shredded cabbage, sliced radish, lime and fried tortilla strips.SweetsSopaipillas with honeyPuffed fried pastry pillows drizzled with honeyHow to make it250g plain flour2 tsp baking powder20g butter125ml honey2 L vegetable oil160ml water1/2 tsp saltMix the flour, the baking powder, the salt and the butter, then add the warm water to a soft dough.Rest 20 minutes, roll 5mm thick and cut into squares.Fry in the vegetable oil at 185°C for 1 minute a side until puffed.Tear open and fill with honey.DrinksOppie's very dry martiniGin with a splash of dry vermouth, honey and lime on the rimHow to make it240ml gin20ml dry vermouth1 lime1 tbsp honeyTouch the rim of the chilled glasses with a little honey and lime.For each drink, stir the gin with a splash of dry vermouth over ice and strain in.Serve iced lime soda the same way for anyone off the gin.Gin and tonic with limeKitty pours her own. Stronger than Oppie's.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
